column2: Gleamblossom, hatchling, if you have the patience to look for it. One grows about sixty paces south of here.
The hands come to the cooking spit when the work is done. That is why I stand here. It is about five paces west-south-west of me. Go and sit by it, hatchling. Eat something.
I am Salith. I came up from Lilmoth to sell to the hands. I stayed because I am the only one here who feeds them properly. Hungry people buy, hatchling, so here I stand.
I sell food and small goods, hatchling, to anyone with the coin and to a few who owe me for last week. Do not tell me you have eaten when your ribs say otherwise. Eat something.

Okan-Wul is usually about five paces north of here; I mother that hatchling, whatever they say. Stares-At-Clouds is about twenty-five paces north-north-east, lazy and sweet. For Uleesh, go about forty-five paces east to the shallows below the walls of Lilmoth; he fishes there. He is the most honest man outside the walls.
